title: Bug 648535: Reprice subcontracting lines after scheduling
summary: Subcontracting purchase lines are now repriced after backward scheduling finalizes the order date and manufacturing fields are transferred from requisition lines, ensuring prices reflect the correct effective date.
key_points: Repricing occurs after requisition-to-purchase manufacturing fields are transferred
Repricing is reapplied when Expected Receipt Date reschedules Order Date
Repricing is triggered when Order Date is directly validated
Non-subcontracting purchase lines remain unchanged via existing guards
Added test coverage for the repricing scenarios
quote: Subcontracting purchase lines were priced before backward scheduling had finalized the purchase-line Order Date.
